answer: Require every new identity's work to be accepted on both sides of a public attestation bridge that joins two independently administered groups, each an orchard of already-established peers. A farm that lives in a single nebula of mutually endorsing keys can fill one side, but not both, because the two orchards do not share recent co-sign sets. Failed two-sided attestation leaves the work unpaid; repeated one-sided clusters slash a posted bond, so each extra head needs real counterparties on both banks.
